bot.name: PurpleWave

formats.notes: sb.5 completed a natural Protoss-versus-Zerg x64 1v1; Terran has x64 opening evidence and Protoss has x86 smoke/reload evidence. Scope and unclassified command rejections: docs/releases/purplewave-sb-5.md.

learning.notes: Opponent history, placement caches, and logs stay in the isolated profile. Reset read and write to the empty baseline to clear learning; compatible history is preserved across updates.
